query: WITH daily AS ( SELECT DISTINCT date_trunc('day', reviewed_at) AS day FROM review_events re JOIN review_cards rc ON rc.id = re.card_id WHERE rc.user_id = $1 ORDER BY day DESC ), numbered AS ( SELECT day, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY day DESC) AS rn FROM daily ) SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM numbered WHERE day = current_date - make_interval(days => (rn - 1)::int)
